status: Independent complete supported-profile smoothing matches 2713 original outcomes across two explicit reference sessions, plus all 15 retained pipeline targets. Other prior/optimizer modes and full conversion remain unfinished.
default_prior: All ten GUI profiles use prior type 3. Original 0x494730 evaluates three consecutive contour nodes and 0x494840 produces derivatives for the first and last node. Main phase prior strength is applied elsewhere in the complete objective.
curvature_api: curvaturePrior({ points, sampleCounts, lengthWeight }) takes three finite double coordinate pairs, two positive int32 original-sample counts, and a finite nonnegative double length weight. Return energy plus owned firstGradient and lastGradient float64 vectors. Do not clamp cancellation or replace native operation order with algebraic rearrangements.
curvature_energy: Let incoming=middle-first and outgoing=last-middle, with lengths a and b and corresponding unit directions u and v. Compute sqrt(2-2*dot(u,v)+0.001) + ((b/sampleCounts[1]-a/sampleCounts[0])*lengthWeight)*(b/sampleCounts[1]-a/sampleCounts[0]) in native double operation order.
curvature_gradient: Return original endpoint derivatives, including both regularized direction change and per-original-sample length mismatch. The middle-node derivative belongs to the outer objective's accumulation and is not a separate native output here.
quadratic_api: quadraticPrior({ points, sampleCounts }) returns the squared change in per-original-sample displacement and owned firstGradient/lastGradient double vectors. It shares the curvature prior's point and count validation. Original 0x493ee0/0x494580 supply this term for regions smaller than eight pixels and for the node-flag-0x10 inversion prior, even when the selected main prior is type 3.
objective_api: smoothingObjective({ geometry, referencePositions, penaltyCounts, borderCounts, parameters, phase }) returns energy and an owned flat float64 gradient. geometry supplies current node x/y/flags plus region pixelCount, contour identifiers and boundary triples. referencePositions supplies two channels per node, normalized to original float32 reference-cache storage. penaltyCounts supplies the original byte at node+0x1e. borderCounts is the original four-group left/right/top/bottom node count. phase is 0, 1 or 2. For measurement code 1, supply imageModel from createContourImageModel for matching region contours, pixel counts and dimensions. The caller can retain this model across objective calls.
objective_scope: Prepared smoothing objective with measurement codes 0, 1 and 2 and prior codes 0 and 3. Image code 1 uses the supplied persistent image model. The anti-alias repair callback flag is disabled in these native prepared references; no automatic initial perturbation, repair or full phase dispatch is implied. Prior code 1 remains unfinished and is rejected.
objective_order: Visit regions and contour samples in order. Node flag 0x10 adds the quadratic term scaled by anti_inv_pot_prior_scale/prior_strength. Regions smaller than eight pixels use the quadratic main prior; larger regions use the selected prior unless boundary flag bit 1 disables it. Multiply accumulated prior energy and derivatives by phase strength. Add signed-area pressure for small regions, then reference-position measurement, then byte-count-scaled anti_inv_pot_meas_scale penalties. Finally apply native border-gradient constraints. Image measurement energy updates cached records/colors at its original position in this order. Image gradients add individual pixel contributions directly into the prior gradient; derivative-only updates reuse the last energy records.
objective_reference_precision: Reference positions occupy float32 cache fields. Accumulate signed shoelace area in contour order and multiply by 0.5 after summation. Preserve native addition and product order for every energy and gradient contribution. Do not take absolute area or recompute the central derivative by a combined endpoint sum.
precision: The original uses x87 control word 0x027f, selecting 53-bit precision. Each arithmetic instruction rounds to double. Preserve products, sums, division, square-root and sign order recovered from assembly.
degenerate_segments: Collapsed adjacent nodes produce native NaN curvature energies and endpoint derivatives with masked IEEE exceptions. Preserve these results; do not introduce epsilon lengths or clamping. The quadratic fallback remains defined for collapsed coordinates. Full optimizer admissible-step handling is a separate recovery task.
full_stage: Original 0x497c30 raw preparation, shared-PRNG anti-alias initialization, enabled optimizer phases, per-phase corner puncturing and final repair/decay are independently implemented. Exact comparisons cover all nine basic profiles, all eight phase masks, three corner schedules and line-search modes 0/5. Other optimizer/prior modes and nonfinite controller trajectories remain under recovery.
completion: Supported-profile prepared smoothing passes bounded native differential comparisons. This does not establish fitting, export, decoding, automatic classification or complete application parity.

line_search_api: smoothingLineSearch({ ...preparedObjective, width, height, nearBorderNodes, direction, epsilon }) owns returned flat float64 positions and exposes final energy, returned native delta, next epsilon, accumulated step and line iteration count. nearBorderNodes supplies the prepared native cache of interior node identifiers; the evaluator does not rebuild it from moved coordinates. direction is an explicit finite flat float64 vector. This function explicitly invokes the quadratic primitive, independently of the profile line-search dispatcher. It does not compute a descent direction or run a full optimizer.
line_search_order: Copy selected phase CG configuration, use the native backup/restore path and original fixed epsilon decay, cap initial epsilon by maximum coordinate displacement, evaluate two sequential epsilon steps and the bounded parabola candidate, apply native tie/acceptance rules, shrink and clamp epsilon, repeat by native relative improvement and iteration rules, then update epsilon from the total accepted step if configured. Preserve sequential moves and exact arithmetic order. After every move, reset the fixed image borders and clamp cached nearby interior nodes to [0.01,width-0.01] and [0.01,height-0.01]. The fixed native epsilon decay is 0.5; the phase cg_step_fraction controls the next epsilon derived from the accepted accumulated step.
optimizer_api: smoothingOptimize({ ...preparedObjective, width, height, nearBorderNodes }) runs the original Fletcher-Reeves controller for the explicit prepared objective with optimizer type 0 and line-search type 0 or 5. Return owned positions and controller state. Without nearbyEdges this remains the prepared controller with anti-alias callbacks disabled. Supply nearbyEdges and repairInterval for prepared anti-alias callbacks; return repairState with owned flags and penaltyCounts. These inputs describe fixed preparation state. Initial perturbation, corner puncturing and full phase dispatch are still excluded.
optimizer_order: Initialize epsilon to phase maximum, compute energy and constrained gradient, set direction to negative gradient and sum squared norm in channel order. Maintain the original best-energy baseline, countdown and minimum/maximum iteration stopping, norm-ratio Fletcher-Reeves beta, alignment/restart schedule, and per-step epsilon updates. Compare the prepared controller as a complete unit against native entry 0x4adf00.
optimizer_state: Return owned positions, storedGradient and direction Float64Arrays plus energy, baseline, epsilon, step, beta, iterations, restarts, lineIterations and countdown. The native iterations field is incremented after refreshing the gradient and direction; stopping before that refresh leaves storedGradient and direction from the preceding evaluation. It can therefore differ from the total line-call count.
optimizer_scope: Prepared model with optimizer 0, line-search 0/5, measurements 0/1/2 and priors 0/3. Image measurement 1 requires the matching persistent model. Blend preadjustment and shared-PRNG jitter are implemented at their explicit preparation boundary. Corner puncturing is implemented at its separate stage boundary. Nonfinite controller trajectories remain unfinished. Multi-phase dispatch is implemented separately through CoreSession.smoothContours.
cached_line_search: Native line-search type 5 alternates seeing and blind moves in a cycle of cg_num_seeing_steps + cg_num_blind_steps. Seeing moves run the recovered quadratic search and update the rolling accepted-step estimate using cg_blind_blend_latest. Blind moves save coordinates, cap the rolling estimate by maximum displacement, move by 0.8 of that estimate and evaluate energy. An uphill blind move restores saved coordinates without a callback, restores the base energy and resets the cycle to a seeing move. Then advance the cycle position. Preserve the native stale accumulated-step field on blind-only iterations.

cli.input: Prepared width/height/BGRA pixels, region indices/palette, raw geometry and a settings object. Resolve only the smoothing stage using existing basic or advanced settings; start one fresh CoreSession per process.
